title: Acceptance admission refuses a landed item's exact-commit terminal pass recorded under an earlier claim (committed_input_no_eligible_run), forcing a rerun to close landed work
outcome: Acceptance admission refuses a landed item's exact-commit terminal pass recorded under an earlier claim (committed_input_no_eligible_run), forcing a rerun to close landed work
acceptance: The cause is identified from source (src/acceptance_committed_input.rs and the admission path): why an exact-commit terminal passing committed-input run of the item, recorded under an earlier claim of the same item, is not eligible for a later claim's evaluation at the same named-root HEAD, and whether that exclusion protects a real invariant.

Either admission accepts such a run for the same item at the same exact commit (same project, item and committed source identity), or an evidence-only route lets a landed item's evaluation use its recorded exact-commit pass without a fresh run; in both cases nothing is accepted from a different item, commit or tree.

Behaviour tests cover: an earlier-claim exact-commit pass admitted (or routed) for a later claim; a different-commit, different-item or non-terminal run still refused with committed_input_no_eligible_run; and the existing admission tests keep their outcomes.
